appliedUpdates.description: Created .factory/library/storybook.md documenting the react-docgen vs react-docgen-typescript tradeoff in Storybook 9 (CVA VariantProps show as unknown in ArgTypes).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update the 'Reserved / planned local ports' section to clarify that Storybook underlying port 4311 is a default fallback only — when running through Portless, the actual port is dynamically assigned via the PORT env var. Consider adding a note: 'When Portless manages the app, the PORT env var overrides the default. 4311 is used only when running Storybook directly without Portless.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature storybook-stabilize-portless-startup-surface (commit bec5de1) changed apps/storybook/package.json to use --port ${PORT:-4311}. Three reviewers noted the AGENTS.md port listing is now slightly inaccurate since ports are dynamic under Portless.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a note about the web service having the same PORT env var mismatch that was fixed for Storybook: the web service start command uses PORTLESS_APP_PORT=4310 (which is not a real Portless env var) and hardcodes --port 4310, while Portless assigns a dynamic port via PORT. This should be addressed in the web-migration-cleanup milestone.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature storybook-stabilize-portless-startup-surface reviewer noted services.yaml web service uses the same anti-pattern that caused Storybook 502s. The portless.md knowledge file now documents that PORTLESS_APP_PORT has no effect.
